title: Watch it count
starter:
a = 0
say(f"a equal {a}")
step(1)
a = a + 1
say(f"a equal {a}")
step(1)
a = a + 1
say(f"a equal {a}")
step(1)
a = a + 1
say(f"a equal {a}")
step(1)
a = a + 1
say(f"a equal {a}")
grab()
hints: The bug 🐞 is on: press Step (not Run) and watch the line with ▶ and the number a under the console.
a counts the steps the monkey takes. When it reaches the end, what does a say, and how many squares away is the {B}?
The {B} is 5 squares away, but the monkey counts only to 4. Add one more step(1) before grab().

sk.title: Sleduj, ako počíta
hints: Chrobák 🐞 je zapnutý: stláčaj Krok (nie Spusti) a sleduj riadok so ▶ a číslo a pod konzolou.
a počíta kroky opičky. Keď dôjde na koniec, koľko hovorí a a koľko políčok je {B} ďaleko?
{B} je 5 políčok ďaleko, ale opička napočíta len do 4. Pridaj ešte jeden step(1) pred grab().
